title: Joshua Malina on His Big Bang Theory Role

author: HBO Max
description:
The wartime universe has arrived! On Season 1, Episode 8 of the Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Official Podcast, Joshua Malina joins Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton to reveal how Big Bang Theory’s President Siebert became the spectacularly unhelpful Captain Siebert.

Then art director Walter Eckert gives fans behind-the-scenes access to the making of war-torn Pasadena, the centaur universe, and a reinvented comic book shop built to feel familiar while finally showing all four walls.

✅ How a fan post and one shameless message to Bill Prady landed Joshua Malina a role in SFTSTU
✅ Why Captain Siebert gives his doomed clients only “35%” during the firing-squad tribunal
✅ Joshua explains the huge creative difference between his early and final seasons on The Big Bang Theory
✅ The unbelievable true story of Joshua saving Aaron Sorkin’s life at a Broadway bowling night
✅ Walter reveals how the team destroyed Pasadena, designed the centaurs, and rebuilt the comic book shop in about a month
🔔
